title: Noninvasive Positive Pressure Ventilation (NIPPV) in the Home for the Treatment of Chronic Respiratory Failure (CRF) Consequent to Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
service: Home noninvasive ventilation for chronic respiratory failure due to COPD

criteria.text: Awake PaCO2 >= 52 mmHg on ABG while on prescribed FiO2
criteria.span: The patient exhibits persistent hypercapnia as demonstrated by PaCO2 ≥ 52 mmHg by arterial blood gas during awake hours while breathing his/her prescribed FiO2

criteria.text: Sleep apnea not the predominant cause of hypercapnia (formal sleep test not required if the clinician so determines)
criteria.span: Sleep apnea is not the predominant cause of the hypercapnia

criteria.text: RAD with backup rate: stable COPD (no >1 worsening symptom >= 2 days and no medication change in prior 2 weeks) or hypercapnia >= 2 weeks after an exacerbation requiring acute NIV
criteria.span: Stable COPD, without increase in or new onset of more than one respiratory symptom (cough, sputum production, sputum purulence, wheezing, or dyspnea) lasting 2 or more days and no change of pharmacological treatment during the 2-week period before initiation of NIV

criteria.text: At discharge: required RAD or ventilator in the 24 h before discharge and clinician documents risk of rapid worsening
criteria.span: if the patient required either a RAD or ventilator within the 24-hour period prior to hospital discharge and the treating clinician determines that the patient is at risk of rapid symptom exacerbation or rise in PaCO2 after discharge

criteria.text: Continued RAD coverage (first evaluation by 6 months): use >= 4 h per 24 h on >= 70% of days in a 30-day period
criteria.span: the patient must be determined by a clinician to use the RAD at least 4 hours per 24-hour period, on at least 70% of days in a 30-day period

criteria.text: Continued RAD coverage: at least one outcome (PaCO2 normalization, stabilization of rising PaCO2, 20% reduction, or improved hypercapnia symptom)
criteria.span: 20% reduction in PaCO2 from baseline value

criteria.text: Home mechanical ventilator: additionally needs FiO2 >= 36% or >= 4 L O2, > 8 h/day support, alarms/battery need, or needs exceeding a RAD
criteria.span: Requires oxygen therapy at an FiO2 ≥ 36% or ≥ 4L nasally

notes: Unlike CPAP NCD 240.4, this NCD itself states the 4 hours/24h on 70% of days usage rule.
